title: Cyan Rose
description: This data and resource pack replaces the golden dandelion with the beautiful cyan rose from old Minecraft! it is obtainable from the sniffer, giving it a cool use and crafts into cyan dye!
body: You can obtain the rose from sniffers digging them up, it has the same chance as the other sniffer flowers. The flower still has all its regular functions, stopping mob growth and being potted. **ADD TO BOTH RESOURCE PACKS AND DATAPACKS!!!** **RENAME ONLY WORKS FOR EN.US!!!**  Also it says for older version but don't listen it works fine.
